gloss: reading widely without plan; indiscriminate reading

definitions.gloss: reading widely and unsystematically; indiscriminate reading
definitions.explanation: Reading many different books without a particular plan or focus, jumping from one subject or genre to another. Can be seen positively (voracious reading) or negatively (unfocused reading).

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{乱読|らんどく}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I was young, I read widely without any plan.

examples.japanese: {乱読|らんどく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{悪|わる}くない→悪い：00908_warui⟧。⟦{思|おも}わぬ→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Reading indiscriminately isn't bad. You make unexpected discoveries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手当|てあ}たり⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乱読|らんどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: My holiday pleasure is reading whatever catches my eye at the library.

notes:
A reading style where one reads broadly across genres and topics without a structured plan. Some writers and intellectuals praise {乱読|らんどく} as a way to broaden one's horizons, while others criticize it as unfocused.

FORMS:
{乱|らん} (random, disorderly) + {読|どく} (reading)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乱読|らんどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to read indiscriminately
- {乱読|らんどく}{家|か}: a voracious/indiscriminate reader
- {乱読|らんどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧すすめ: recommendation of wide reading

CONTRASTING READING STYLES:
- ⟦{精読|せいどく}→精読：15982_seidoku⟧: close/careful reading — reading one text thoroughly
- ⟦{速読|そくどく}→速読：22402_sokudoku⟧: speed reading — reading quickly
- ⟦{多読|たどく}→多読：15981_tadoku⟧: extensive reading — reading a large quantity, but often with more purpose than {乱読|らんどく}
- {濫読|らんどく}: same meaning, alternate kanji (less common)
